- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Lady Ada expresses surprise and interest in how energy trading will be made free.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sir Wattsworth explains that smart contracts will enable transparent, automated, and secure energy trading.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sir Wattsworth compares energy trading to a flock of wild coconuts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Lady Ada inquires about the tokens used in the system.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sir Wattsworth introduces JouleCoin, which rewards participants in peer-to-peer energy transactions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] JouleCoins can be redeemed for energy, used for staking, or converted into other cryptocurrencies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Lady Ada questions how the startup will handle regulations.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sir Wattsworth mentions enlisting Sir Legalese, a knight-attorney, to navigate regulatory compliance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Lady Ada expresses intrigue about the potential of Ye Olde Microgrid and asks about the investment needed.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sir Wattsworth states that the startup seeks an investment of 500,000 US dollars.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sir Wattsworth explains that the investment will be used to expand the team, develop technology, and spread influence.
